description: This dataset adds the citation data contained in the [February 2026 version of Crossref](https://api.crossref.org/snapshots/monthly/2026/02/all.json.tar.gz) and the [August 2025 version of JaLC](https://api.japanlinkcenter.org/). Also this version introduces two new sources: [OUTCITE](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18172742) and [Matilda](https://matilda.science).

additional_files.name: Citation data sources' info (N-Triple)
additional_files.note: Information regarding the data source collection (e.g., COCI, DOCI, POCI, etc) of all the citation data

additional_files.name: Citation count data (CSV)
additional_files.note: The number of incoming citations to each bibliographic entity (identified by a DOI) in OpenCitations Index

additional_files.name: OpenCitations OMID Index for Bibliographic Resources (BR) and Responsible Agents (RA) (CSV)
